name: newscat
description: A pixel-art cherub who delivers twice-daily headlines on macOS.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.lint: biome lint && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.dist:adhoc: npm run build && electron scripts/dmg-background.mjs && electron-builder --mac -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false -c.dmg.sign=false
